_comment: Review of the DSAR ladder copy by the reviewer model, run through the gate lane's own gate.py (check -> pending -> review -> check) in a scratch mirror of both branches. The bodies are the copy file's variants with example dates (received 11 November 2026, due 11 December 2026, next 26 November 2026): fixed wording, no personal data. The statements were signed with a THROWAWAY key that exists only in the scratch mirror, so none of these is a verdict the production gate accepts; production verdicts come from the gate lane's reviewer round under the pinned key.

items.note: States both dates, asks only to write from the account email or app, says the request stays open.
Rule 2: asks for a document 'from that person', which is not on the allowed list; limited to a label/management document and told how to send it.
items.replacement: Hello, We received your request on 11 November 2026. It is logged and we are working on it. The law gives us one month from the day we received it to answer, so you will have our answer by 11 December 2026 at the latest. You are writing on behalf of someone else. Before we can act on a Muso page, we need to connect that page to you. Please reply to this message with a document from the artist's label or management that names you as authorised to act for the page. You do not need to send a passport or any other identity document. Your request stays open while you do this. Muso.AI Support
